title: Emotional Cheating
summary: Emotional cheating is forming a secretive, intimate emotional bond with someone outside the relationship that crosses the couple's agreed boundaries, even without physical contact.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
